g.text: End-to-end time and reported peak RSS across ten datasets
Bars: end-to-end time (left axis). Dots: reported peak RSS (right axis, shared scale). Lower is better.
TO: 4 h timeout; tall broken bars are symbolic and NOT to scale. Hollow dots: v2 main-process RSS only; child processes excluded.
Historical runs and selected v2 reruns; cache states / epoch counts differ; v2 Ratebeer is capped. RSS for timed-out runs is the peak observed before timeout.
